Aviation is theabestgood example we have of a complex system of technology, business process and people that learned to be safe, and I keep coming back to it, in [The ultimate insider](../../ultimate-insider-three-collisions.md) and in [The investigation GitHub owes its customers](../../the-investigation-github-owes-its-customers.md). But let us be clear about why. It did not get there for altruistic reasons, or because it was the right thing to do, although, to be fair, the people who run airlines also fly, so they have some interest of their own. It got there because everybody knew that every crash, anywhere in the world, would be news, and more so every year.
